Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}

A faction of @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.oWsHHlI3OS7cwvaF]{Ravnos} who split from their Gypsy heritage after the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s formation, these antitribu retain their parent clan's nomadic instincts and gift for illusion while pledging themselves to the Sword of Caine.

Disciplines: Animalism, Chimerstry, Fortitude

Advantage: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.oWsHHlI3OS7cwvaF]{Ravnos} may take a Contacts Trait or Street Influence at no additional cost during character creation, reflecting the value they place on connections that keep them safe. Their nomadic experience also grants them an additional Survival or Stealth Ability at no extra cost.

Disadvantage: Blood proves stronger than politics - @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.oWsHHlI3OS7cwvaF]{Ravnos} antitribu retain their parent clan's compulsive vice, a 'signature crime' such as theft, murder, con games, or feeding on the inebriated. Whenever confronted with the opportunity to indulge this vice, the character must do so unless she succeeds at a three-Trait Self-Control/Instinct test.

Organization: True to their roots, Ravnos antitribu favor mobile, loosely affiliated bands over fixed haven life, moving between Sabbat territories as opportunity and vice dictate.
